verdict.rationale: The xAI docs document a US regional endpoint (`https://us.api.x.ai/v1`) that keeps request handling and model inference in the United States. That is a real residency control, but it covers processing location for a single region rather than a choice of where data is stored. Missing for 10: multiple selectable regions (e.g., EU), explicit at-rest storage residency guarantees for files/collections/retained data, and independent corroboration.
